name: Music streaming subscription
definition: plan giving on-demand access to a library of recorded music.

name: Satellite and internet radio subscription
definition: paid subscription to a network of radio channels received by satellite or over the internet.
notes: SiriusXM plans car + app radio subscription

name: Audiobook catalogue subscription
definition: plan giving access to a catalogue of audiobooks to listen to while subscribed (credits it renews are a plan attribute; titles bought with them are I2).

name: Paid podcast subscription
definition: paid plan giving access to one or more podcasts' paid episodes or feeds.

name: On-demand streaming video subscription
definition: plan giving on-demand access to a streamed library of film, series or sport (SVOD, OTT; a live-sport service is here).

name: Live-TV streaming bundle
definition: plan streaming a bundle of linear TV channels over the internet (vMVPD).

name: Pay-TV package (cable, satellite, IPTV)
definition: subscription package of TV channels delivered by cable, satellite or IPTV, unless named for the line.

name: Newspaper subscription (one title)
definition: subscription to one newspaper title, delivered in print, digitally or both.

name: Magazine subscription (one title)
definition: subscription to one magazine title, delivered in print, digitally or both.

name: News and magazine library subscription (many titles)
definition: plan giving access to a library of many newspaper and magazine titles.

name: E-book library subscription
definition: plan giving access to a library of e-books to read while subscribed.

name: Comic and manga library subscription
definition: plan giving access to a library of comics or manga to read while subscribed.

name: Recorded class subscription
definition: plan giving access to a library of recorded or streamed lessons, sessions or classes to watch or listen to (the subject divides nothing, I-20).

name: Game subscription (catalogue, online play, cloud)
definition: plan giving access to a catalogue of games, online play or cloud play on a platform or store.

name: Single-game subscription
definition: subscription required or sold to play one game.
notes: FFXIV subscription fees required to play

name: In-game season or battle pass
definition: pass bought for a season of one game that unlocks its reward track.

name: Asset-library subscription
definition: plan giving access to a library of images, video, sounds, fonts or templates for making work (each asset licensed under it is I2).

name: Multi-service bundle
definition: one plan bundling several subscription services, filed here when named for none of its components.

name: Creator membership
definition: paid membership giving one creator's paid posts, channel or feed, whatever the medium (a free follow is OUT).

name: Cloud storage and sync plan
definition: plan giving online storage for the user's files, with sync between devices.

name: Online backup plan
definition: plan keeping the user's backup on the provider's servers, even with its own client program.

name: Email service
definition: mailbox and address service, free or paid (a program used only to read and send mail is I1).

name: Messaging, calling and video-conferencing service
definition: service for sending messages and making voice or video calls and meetings over the internet.

name: Maps and navigation service
definition: online map and route-finding service, free or paid.

name: Personal hosting plan (web hosting, game server)
definition: plan renting server space for a personal website or game server (hosting sold as business infrastructure is not filed).
notes: Hostinger shared hosting plans personal sites

name: Mobile phone plan (Handytarif)
definition: mobile plan for calls, texts and data on a SIM or eSIM, contract or prepaid, with or without a handset (the handset is its own object).

name: Mobile data plan (data-only SIM, dongle, router)
definition: mobile plan giving data only, for a data SIM, dongle or mobile router.

name: Fixed-line broadband plan
definition: home internet plan over a fixed line (fibre, copper or cable as `technology`).

name: Satellite internet plan
definition: home internet plan delivered by satellite through a dish.

name: Home phone line plan
definition: plan for a fixed home telephone line.

name: Bundled connectivity package (phone, internet, TV) (Kombi-Tarif)
definition: one plan bundling a connection with phone or TV, named and sold for the line.

name: Renewing travel eSIM plan
definition: travel data plan on an eSIM that renews each period (one-off packs are OUT).

name: Facility membership
definition: membership of one operator's facility or facilities (gym, pool, sports centre, climbing wall).

name: Members' club
definition: membership of a club joined to take part in its activity (sports, social or hobby).

name: Multi-studio class pass
definition: pass giving bookings at classes across many studios, often paid in renewing credits (`credits_per_period` a plan attribute).

name: Multi-site membership
definition: membership giving entry to one body's network of sites.

name: Multi-venue pass scheme
definition: pass giving entry to many bodies' venues under one scheme.

name: Single-venue annual pass
definition: annual pass or membership for one museum, zoo, garden, aquarium or theme park.

name: Period transit pass (定期券)
definition: pass for travel on a network or route valid for a period or a number of journeys (alias: season ticket, UK rail).

name: Car-sharing membership
definition: membership giving access to a shared vehicle fleet (trips, hire fees and fuel are one-off services, OUT).

name: Season ticket (venue, club or event series)
definition: ticket giving entry to a season or series of events at a venue or of a club.

name: Provider-curated box
definition: recurring delivery whose contents the provider picks, including a merchant's case plan.

name: Member-selected menu plan
definition: recurring delivery whose contents the member picks from the provider's menu (meal kits, coffee, books).
notes: Meal Delivery and cooking category HelloFresh

name: Producer allocation club
definition: a producer's own club that allocates its own goods to members on a schedule.

name: Goods rental subscription
definition: subscription lending goods to be used and returned (clothes, furniture, toys, instruments, art; the rented goods are not owned and not filed).
